newImages.prompt:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. Three children arrive one after another at the same classroom door, three positions connected by arrows to show repeated successive arrivals, NOT changing seasons.
2. A child writes with a much-used favorite wooden pencil beside its familiar worn pencil case, clearly loving and repeatedly using this tool.
3. A room flooded with daylight through a large window, bright and well lit.
4. A child who has stopped trying to ride a bicycle, sitting beside the bike looking resigned, another attempt abandoned.
5. A child astonished and exasperated looking at a cake that has toppled over.
6. An energetic child enthusiastically running outdoors.
7. A child looking admiringly at an older soccer player, wishing to play that well; NO jersey numbers.
8. A child standing in ankle-deep clear river water, visible bottom close to the surface, shallow water.
9. ONE within-cell paired scene: child hands a book to a librarian who safely keeps it for the child. Librarian and child wear green and yellow. Book yellow. No pink or magenta artwork.
10. A mother directly gives a blue gift box to a delighted child.
11. Ordinary everyday scene: morning sun rising over houses, the usual natural daily event, sunrise NOT a supernatural scene.
12. A cook skillfully handling a frying pan, clearly operating a tool.
13. A hand puts a puzzle piece into its matching opening, piece and opening shapes match exactly.
14. A young performer on stage reacting spontaneously to dropping a juggling ball, turning the unexpected mistake into a funny friendly bow; pair inside ONE cell.
15. An analog clock showing time with hands and tick marks, no numerals or letters.
16. Water overflowing the rim of a full glass onto a table.
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades. Magenta ONLY in grid lines.

newImages.prompt:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. Three children arrive one after another at the same classroom door, three positions connected by arrows to show repeated successive arrivals, NOT changing seasons.
2. A child writes with a much-used favorite wooden pencil beside its familiar worn pencil case, clearly loving and repeatedly using this tool.
3. A room flooded with daylight through a large window, bright and well lit.
4. A child who has stopped trying to ride a bicycle, sitting beside the bike looking resigned, another attempt abandoned.
5. A child astonished and exasperated looking at a cake that has toppled over.
6. An energetic child enthusiastically running outdoors.
7. A child looking admiringly at an older soccer player, wishing to play that well; NO jersey numbers.
8. A child standing in ankle-deep clear river water, visible bottom close to the surface, shallow water.
9. ONE within-cell paired scene: child hands a book to a librarian who safely keeps it for the child. Librarian and child wear green and yellow. Book yellow. No pink or magenta artwork.
10. A mother directly gives a blue gift box to a delighted child.
11. Ordinary everyday scene: morning sun rising over houses, the usual natural daily event, sunrise NOT a supernatural scene.
12. A cook skillfully handling a frying pan, clearly operating a tool.
13. A hand puts a puzzle piece into its matching opening, piece and opening shapes match exactly.
14. A young performer on stage reacting spontaneously to dropping a juggling ball, turning the unexpected mistake into a funny friendly bow; pair inside ONE cell.
15. An analog clock showing time with hands and tick marks, no numerals or letters.
16. Water overflowing the rim of a full glass onto a table.
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades. Magenta ONLY in grid lines.

Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. Rain briefly falls and then the sun comes out again; a temporary shower, before/after pair in ONE cell.
2. A person tenderly cuddles a beloved puppy with affectionate expression, no pink clothing.
3. A child visibly refuses a plate of vegetables, palms raised and head turning aside.
4. A cat on TOP of a bookshelf, clearly above the books below, small upward arrow beside shelf.
5. A child SETS A LITTLE WOODEN TOY BOAT onto the surface of a pond with one hand, boat visibly floating. This is floating something, not a gift.
6. A child happily ACCEPTS a proposal to play from a friend who holds a ball; welcoming nod and open gesture.
7. A grandparent hands a family gardening watering can to a child in a garden, passing responsibility for tending plants to the next person, not a formal application.
8. A receptionist at a desk RECEIVES a paper APPLICATION from a visitor, no readable text.
9. A child CATCHES an approaching baseball in a glove, clear incoming motion and catching.
10. A child PUSHES a wooden box so its POSITION CHANGES, small arrow shows movement.
11. ONE before/after pair: a toy train first still and then STARTS MOVING along the track; initial train without motion streaks and second with motion arrow.
12. A child turned BACK TOWARD THE VIEWER; back of their head and blue jacket visible.
13. A dim room at dusk with weak lamplight; clearly not pitch black but poorly lit.
14. ONE before/after pair: clear water poured into orange juice, final liquid paler and diluted, hand pouring visible.
15. A child CROUCHES low with knees bent, body rounded and arms near knees.
16. A rocket launching UPWARD into the sky, no child using explosives, no text.

newImages.prompt:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. 大人しい：さわがず、しずかにしているようす。
2. 驚かす：ひとを、びっくりさせること。
3. 思い出す：まえのことを、もういちどこころにうかべること。
4. 思い付く：あたらしいかんがえなどが、こころにうかぶこと。
5. 折り返す：そでやかみなどを、もとのほうへおりもどすこと。
6. オリジナル：まねではなく、もとになったものや、じぶんでつくったもの。
7. 会計：お金の出入りを計算し、記録すること。
8. 海中：うみの、みずのなか。
9. 快調：ものごとなどが、ちょうしよくすすむようす。
10. 抱える：うでで、ものなどを、だくようにもつこと。
11. 掲げる：はたや、ふだなどを、たかいところへあげてみせること。
12. 輝く：ひかりをだしたり、ひかりをはんしゃしたりして、きらきらすること。 / 光る：ひかりをだしたり、はんしゃしたりすること。
13. 書き上げる：ぶんしょうなどを、さいごまでかきおえること。
14. 書き換える：かいてあるないようを、べつのないようにかえること。 / 書き直す：いちどかいたものを、もういちどかくこと。
15. 書き取る：きいたことばなどを、もじにしてのこすこと。
16. 架空：ほんとうにはなく、かんがえのなかでつくったこと。
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades: use yellow, orange, blue, green, brown, grey clothing and objects. Magenta ONLY in the grid lines. No jersey numbers.

newImages.prompt:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. 簡略：こまかいぶぶんをへらして、かんたんにするようす。
2. 外部：あるものや、たてものなどの、そとのぶぶん。
3. 学割：学生に対して、料金をふつうより安くするしくみ。
4. がんばる：むずかしくても、ちからをだして、とりくみつづけること。
5. 聞き取る：ことばなどをきいて、なにをいったかわかること。
6. 聞こえる：おとが、みみにとどいて、わかること。
7. 奇数：二で割ると一余る整数。一、三、五など。
8. 汚い：よごれなどがついて、きれいではないこと。
9. 厳しい：きまりなどを、しっかりまもるようにもとめること。
10. 決まり：みんなが、まもるようにきめたこと。
11. 窮屈：ひろさなどがたりなくて、うごきにくいようす。
12. 煌びやか：ひかりやいろがはなやかで、めだつようす。
13. 切り替える：つかっているものや、ほうほうを、べつのものにかえること。
14. 切り離す：つながっているものを、きってわけること。
15. 金色：きんぞくのきんのように、かがやくいろ。
16. ぎこちない：うごきなどが、なめらかでなく、かたいようす。
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades: use yellow, orange, blue, green, brown, grey clothing and objects. Magenta ONLY in the grid lines. No jersey numbers.

newImages.prompt: Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects: 1. A hiker climbs a very steep rocky mountain path, difficult rugged slope. 2. A coach warmly encourages a child, child becomes motivated, reassuring supportive gesture. 3. A child looking at their wristwatch RIGHT NOW, highlighting the present moment, no written time. 4. Before/after pair inside this cell: SAME blue car first fast with long speed streaks, then braking with short motion streaks approaching a red traffic light, brake lights visible; deceleration, no crash. 5. Japan map silhouette together with the Japanese flag, illustrating within one country; no country labels. 6. A solid ice cube with flat faces, retains shape instead of flowing. 7. A child enjoys pleasant refreshing breeze in a garden, comfortable happy face. 8. A bundled-up child shivering in snowy weather, freezing cold, no injury. 9. An apple beside an orange, clearly different kinds of fruit. 10. Three separately wrapped presents spaced apart, one for each recipient, individual handling. 11. A child pushes a red ball so it rolls forward along the ground; ball rolling and child causing it are in the same scene. 12. A compact folded blue umbrella fits in one hand. 13. A child walking upstream along the river toward the mountain source: water arrows flow DOWN toward foreground; child arrow points UP toward background in the OPPOSITE direction. 14. A person holds a small blue gift ABOVE their eye level with both hands, lifting up respectfully. 15. A hand INSERTS a white envelope into the opening of a mailbox, inward arrow, no text. 16. A child points with their index finger toward a distant mountain, finger direction clear. All grid lines must be exactly five vertical and five horizontal PURE MAGENTA continuous lines, with no shaded colored fringe. Equal 4x4 spacing. No magenta, pink or violet artwork. No letters or numerals.

KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects: 1. A hiker climbs a very steep rocky mountain path, difficult rugged slope. 2. A coach warmly encourages a child, child becomes motivated, reassuring supportive gesture. 3. A child looking at their wristwatch RIGHT NOW, highlighting the present moment, no written time. 4. Before/after pair inside this cell: SAME blue car first fast with long speed streaks, then braking with short motion streaks approaching a red traffic light, brake lights visible; deceleration, no crash. 5. Japan map silhouette together with the Japanese flag, illustrating within one country; no country labels. 6. A solid ice cube with flat faces, retains shape instead of flowing. 7. A child enjoys pleasant refreshing breeze in a garden, comfortable happy face. 8. A bundled-up child shivering in snowy weather, freezing cold, no injury. 9. An apple beside an orange, clearly different kinds of fruit. 10. Three separately wrapped presents spaced apart, one for each recipient, individual handling. 11. A child pushes a red ball so it rolls forward along the ground; ball rolling and child causing it are in the same scene. 12. A compact folded blue umbrella fits in one hand. 13. A child walking upstream along the river toward the mountain source: water arrows flow DOWN toward foreground; child arrow points UP toward background in the OPPOSITE direction. 14. A person holds a small blue gift ABOVE their eye level with both hands, lifting up respectfully. 15. A hand INSERTS a white envelope into the opening of a mailbox, inward arrow, no text. 16. A child points with their index finger toward a distant mountain, finger direction clear. All grid lines must be exactly five vertical and five horizontal PURE MAGENTA continuous lines, with no shaded colored fringe. Equal 4x4 spacing. No magenta, pink or violet artwork. No letters or numerals.

newImages.prompt:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. ジャンボ：とてもおおきいようす。
2. 重大：ものごとのえいきょうが、とてもおおきく、たいせつなようす。

newImages.prompt:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. ジャンボ：とてもおおきいようす。
2. 重大：ものごとのえいきょうが、とてもおおきく、たいせつなようす。
3. 純粋：ほかのものが、まざっていないようす。
4. 上等：しなものなどの、しつがよいようす。
5. 迅速：ものごとを、すばやくするようす。 / 素早い：うごきなどが、とてもはやいこと。 / 速やか：じかんをかけずに、すばやくするようす。 / 手早い：どうさなどを、じょうずに、すばやくすること。
6. 吸い込む：いきや、みずなどを、なかへすっていれること。
7. 垂直：二本の直線などが、直角に交わること。
8. 水平：静かな水面のように、横に平らな向き。
9. 優れる：ほかとくらべて、できばえや、せいしつがよいこと。
10. 過ごす：あるばしょや、あるしかたで、じかんをおくること。
11. 進める：ものを、まえのほうへうごかすこと。
12. 酸っぱい：レモンのように、さんみがあること。
13. ストレート：まがらずに、まっすぐであること。
14. 済ませる：しなければならないことを、さいごまでしておえること。
15. 澄み切る：みずやくうきなどが、とてもすんで、にごりがないこと。
16. スムーズ：うごきや、すすみかたが、なめらかなようす。
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades: use yellow, orange, blue, green, brown, grey clothing and objects. Magenta ONLY in the grid lines. No jersey numbers.

newImages.prompt:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. ずらす：もののいちを、すこしよこなどへうごかすこと。 / ずれる：もののいちが、もとのいちから、すこしうごくこと。
2. 静寂：おとがほとんどなく、しずかなこと。
3. 正当：りゆうや、きまりにあっていて、ただしいようす。
4. 精密：こまかいところまで、せいかくにつくられているようす。
5. 背負う：にもつなどを、せなかにのせてはこぶこと。
6. 狭まる：はばなどが、まえよりせまくなること。 / 狭める：はばなどを、まえよりせまくすること。
7. 迫る：ものや、きげんなどが、ちかづいてくること。
8. 繊細：とてもこまかく、ていねいにつくられているようす。
9. 爽快：からだやきもちが、すっきりするようす。
10. 相互：ひとつのほうだけでなく、おたがいどうし。
11. 送別：わかれるひとを、みおくること。
12. 双方：ふたつあるものの、どちらも。
13. 注ぎ込む：みずなどを、ようきのなかへ、ながしいれること。
14. 外側：あるものの、そとのぶぶん。
15. 聳える：やまや、たてものなどが、まわりよりずっとたかくたつこと。
16. 染まる：ぬのなどに、いろがつくこと。
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades: use yellow, orange, blue, green, brown, grey clothing and objects. Magenta ONLY in the grid lines. No jersey numbers.

newImages.scene: 中央：あるものの、まんなかのぶぶん。
newImages.prompt:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. 中央：あるものの、まんなかのぶぶん。
2. 昼夜：ひると、よる。
3. 長期：ながいきかん。
4. 重宝：つかいやすくて、やくにたつようす。
5. 跳躍：じめんをけって、からだをたかくとばすこと。 / 飛び上がる：あしなどでけって、たかいほうへとぶこと。 / 跳ねる：あしなどでけって、からだをうかせること。
6. 調和：いくつかのものが、うまくつりあって、まとまること。
7. 散らかす：ものを、あちこちにおいて、せいりされていないようにすること。 / 散らかる：ものが、あちこちにあって、せいりされていないこと。
8. 散らす：まとまっているものを、あちこちへわけてとばすこと。 / 散らばる：まとまっていたものが、あちこちにわかれること。
9. 浸かる：からだやものが、みずなどのなかにはいること。
10. 突き当たる：すすんでいるとちゅうで、ものにぶつかること。
11. 繕う：やぶれたふくなどを、ぬってなおすこと。
12. 繋がる：はなれていたものなどが、むすばれたり、ついたりすること。
13. 躓く：あるいているときなどに、あしがひっかかり、よろけること。
14. 積み込む：にもつなどを、のりものに、のせていれること。
15. 詰め込む：せまいところなどに、ものをたくさんいれること。
16. 積もる：ゆきなどが、うえにかさなって、おおくなること。
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades: use yellow, orange, blue, green, brown, grey clothing and objects. Magenta ONLY in the grid lines. No jersey numbers.

Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. 中央：あるものの、まんなかのぶぶん。
2. 昼夜：ひると、よる。
3. 長期：ながいきかん。
4. 重宝：つかいやすくて、やくにたつようす。
5. 跳躍：じめんをけって、からだをたかくとばすこと。 / 飛び上がる：あしなどでけって、たかいほうへとぶこと。 / 跳ねる：あしなどでけって、からだをうかせること。
6. 調和：いくつかのものが、うまくつりあって、まとまること。
7. 散らかす：ものを、あちこちにおいて、せいりされていないようにすること。 / 散らかる：ものが、あちこちにあって、せいりされていないこと。
8. 散らす：まとまっているものを、あちこちへわけてとばすこと。 / 散らばる：まとまっていたものが、あちこちにわかれること。
9. 浸かる：からだやものが、みずなどのなかにはいること。
10. 突き当たる：すすんでいるとちゅうで、ものにぶつかること。
11. 繕う：やぶれたふくなどを、ぬってなおすこと。
12. 繋がる：はなれていたものなどが、むすばれたり、ついたりすること。
13. 躓く：あるいているときなどに、あしがひっかかり、よろけること。
14. 積み込む：にもつなどを、のりものに、のせていれること。
15. 詰め込む：せまいところなどに、ものをたくさんいれること。
16. 積もる：ゆきなどが、うえにかさなって、おおくなること。
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades: use yellow, orange, blue, green, brown, grey clothing and objects. Magenta ONLY in the grid lines. No jersey numbers.

newImages.prompt:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. 靡く：かぜなどにおされて、ななめになったり、ゆれたりすること。
2. 生ぬるい：あつくも、つめたくもなく、すこしあたたかいこと。
3. 賑わう：おおくのひとがあつまって、かっきがあること。
4. 逃げる：あぶないところなどから、はなれていくこと。
5. 煮込む：しょくざいを、なべでじかんをかけてにること。
6. にこやか：にこにこと、あかるくわらっているようす。
7. 濁る：みずなどに、こまかいものがまざって、すきとおらなくなること。
8. 滲む：インクなどが、まわりへしみてひろがること。
9. 抜く：ささっているものなどを、ひっぱってとること。
10. 濡らす：みずなどをつけて、しめったじょうたいにすること。
11. 塗り替える：いちどぬったものに、もういちどいろなどをぬること。
12. 寝転ぶ：じめんやゆかなどに、ごろんとねること。
13. 念入り：こまかいところまで、ていねいにするようす。
14. 乗せる：ものを、ほかのもののうえにおくこと。
15. 乗り換える：のっていたのりものをおりて、べつののりものにのること。
16. 乗り越える：もののうえをこえて、むこうがわへいくこと。
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades: use yellow, orange, blue, green, brown, grey clothing and objects. Magenta ONLY in the grid lines. No jersey numbers.

Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. 靡く：かぜなどにおされて、ななめになったり、ゆれたりすること。
2. 生ぬるい：あつくも、つめたくもなく、すこしあたたかいこと。
3. 賑わう：おおくのひとがあつまって、かっきがあること。
4. 逃げる：あぶないところなどから、はなれていくこと。
5. 煮込む：しょくざいを、なべでじかんをかけてにること。
6. にこやか：にこにこと、あかるくわらっているようす。
7. 濁る：みずなどに、こまかいものがまざって、すきとおらなくなること。
8. 滲む：インクなどが、まわりへしみてひろがること。
9. 抜く：ささっているものなどを、ひっぱってとること。
10. 濡らす：みずなどをつけて、しめったじょうたいにすること。
11. 塗り替える：いちどぬったものに、もういちどいろなどをぬること。
12. 寝転ぶ：じめんやゆかなどに、ごろんとねること。
13. 念入り：こまかいところまで、ていねいにするようす。
14. 乗せる：ものを、ほかのもののうえにおくこと。
15. 乗り換える：のっていたのりものをおりて、べつののりものにのること。
16. 乗り越える：もののうえをこえて、むこうがわへいくこと。
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades: use yellow, orange, blue, green, brown, grey clothing and objects. Magenta ONLY in the grid lines. No jersey numbers.

Edit the attached equal 4x4 grid template. Paint 16 separate vocabulary scenes, EACH entirely in its own 1/16 cell. Preserve five horizontal and five vertical continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff lines INCLUDING the outer frame, at exact equal-quarter positions. Keep all dividers. The layout below identifies precise cells, not text to paint:
ROW 1, COLUMN 1: Child enters FROM outside INTO a room through its door, arrow inside.
ROW 1, COLUMN 2: A sprout grows upwards in three stages from soil.
ROW 1, COLUMN 3: Hand peels an adhesive sticker off paper, visibly pulling it AWAY.
ROW 1, COLUMN 4: Chopsticks grip a green pea BETWEEN both tips.
ROW 2, COLUMN 1: Two runners at the starting line START running when a referee raises a flag; start line visible, start of a race.
ROW 2, COLUMN 2: An orange basketball bounces off the ground, a down-then-up curved arrow.
ROW 2, COLUMN 3: Child in a light jacket feeling mildly chilly outdoors.
ROW 2, COLUMN 4: Three friends sit round a table and discuss an idea, speaking and listening.
ROW 3, COLUMN 1: Remove extra unneeded paper sheets from a tall stack, leaving a shorter useful stack.
ROW 3, COLUMN 2: Crayon drawing extends OUTSIDE a black rectangular border on paper.
ROW 3, COLUMN 3: Child running FAST in the middle of a track, speed lines behind, NOT a start line.
ROW 3, COLUMN 4: An enthusiastic child ready to work, holding a pencil with energetic expression.
ROW 4, COLUMN 1: Person pulls a water-filled BUCKET UP out of a well by rope.
ROW 4, COLUMN 2: Person DRAGS a wooden crate along the ground, crate stays on ground.
ROW 4, COLUMN 3: LOW short-legged table, entire table strictly inside this cell, small vertical height arrow.
ROW 4, COLUMN 4: Hand SOAKS white cloth inside a BOWL OF WATER, the bowl and hand fit ENTIRELY INSIDE THIS LAST CELL. Do not merge with table cell.

Edit the attached equal 4x4 grid template. Paint 16 separate vocabulary scenes, EACH entirely in its own 1/16 cell. Preserve five horizontal and five vertical continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff lines INCLUDING the outer frame, at exact equal-quarter positions. Keep all dividers. Do not merge cells, do not omit any scene. Warm clear watercolor style with simple backgrounds. Magenta, pink, purple, violet NEVER used in the art. No text, letters or numbers in the pictures. The layout below identifies precise cells, not text to paint:
ROW 1, COLUMN 1: Child enters FROM outside INTO a room through its door, arrow inside.
ROW 1, COLUMN 2: A sprout grows upwards in three stages from soil.
ROW 1, COLUMN 3: Hand peels an adhesive sticker off paper, visibly pulling it AWAY.
ROW 1, COLUMN 4: Chopsticks grip a green pea BETWEEN both tips.
ROW 2, COLUMN 1: Two runners at the starting line START running when a referee raises a flag; start line visible, start of a race.
ROW 2, COLUMN 2: An orange basketball bounces off the ground, a down-then-up curved arrow.
ROW 2, COLUMN 3: Child in a light jacket feeling mildly chilly outdoors.
ROW 2, COLUMN 4: Three friends sit round a table and discuss an idea, speaking and listening.
ROW 3, COLUMN 1: Remove extra unneeded paper sheets from a tall stack, leaving a shorter useful stack.
ROW 3, COLUMN 2: Crayon drawing extends OUTSIDE a black rectangular border on paper.
ROW 3, COLUMN 3: Child running FAST in the middle of a track, speed lines behind, NOT a start line.
ROW 3, COLUMN 4: An enthusiastic child ready to work, holding a pencil with energetic expression.
ROW 4, COLUMN 1: Person pulls a water-filled BUCKET UP out of a well by rope.
ROW 4, COLUMN 2: Person DRAGS a wooden crate along the ground, crate stays on ground.
ROW 4, COLUMN 3: LOW short-legged table, entire table strictly inside this cell, small vertical height arrow.
ROW 4, COLUMN 4: Hand SOAKS white cloth inside a BOWL OF WATER, the bowl and hand fit ENTIRELY INSIDE THIS LAST CELL. Do not merge with table cell.

ROW 4, COLUMN 1: Person pulls a water-filled BUCKET UP out of a well by rope.
ROW 4, COLUMN 2: Person DRAGS a wooden crate along the ground, crate stays on ground.

newImages.prompt:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. 前向き：かおや、からだを、まえへむけていること。
2. 任せる：じぶんのかわりに、ひとにたのんでしてもらうこと。
3. 真っ暗：ひかりがほとんどなく、なにもみえないほどくらいようす。
4. 真っ直ぐ：まがらずに、ひとつのむきにつづくようす。
5. 間に合う：きめられたじかんより、まえにできること。
6. 丸い：かどがなく、えんやたまのようなかたちをしていること。
7. 見える：もののすがたを、めでたしかめられること。
8. 見つける：さがしたりして、ものがどこにあるかわかること。
9. 捲る：ほんのページなどを、ひっくりかえしてつぎへうつすこと。
10. 戻す：ものを、もとのばしょや、じょうたいにすること。
11. 茹でる：しょくざいを、あついおゆにいれて、ひをとおすこと。
12. 分かち合う：ものや、きもちなどを、おたがいにわけてもつこと。
13. 休む：しごとやがっこうなどを、あるひだけやめること。
14. 眩しい：ひかりがつよく、めをあけているのがつらいこと。
15. 短い：はしからはしまでの、ながさがすくないこと。
16. 見比べる：ふたついじょうのものをみて、ちがいなどをしらべること。
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades: use yellow, orange, blue, green, brown, grey clothing and objects. Magenta ONLY in the grid lines. No jersey numbers.

newImages.prompt:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. 前向き：かおや、からだを、まえへむけていること。
2. 任せる：じぶんのかわりに、ひとにたのんでしてもらうこと。
3. 真っ暗：ひかりがほとんどなく、なにもみえないほどくらいようす。
4. 真っ直ぐ：まがらずに、ひとつのむきにつづくようす。
5. 間に合う：きめられたじかんより、まえにできること。
6. 丸い：かどがなく、えんやたまのようなかたちをしていること。
7. 見える：もののすがたを、めでたしかめられること。
8. 見つける：さがしたりして、ものがどこにあるかわかること。
9. 捲る：ほんのページなどを、ひっくりかえしてつぎへうつすこと。
10. 戻す：ものを、もとのばしょや、じょうたいにすること。
11. 茹でる：しょくざいを、あついおゆにいれて、ひをとおすこと。
12. 分かち合う：ものや、きもちなどを、おたがいにわけてもつこと。
13. 休む：しごとやがっこうなどを、あるひだけやめること。
14. 眩しい：ひかりがつよく、めをあけているのがつらいこと。
15. 短い：はしからはしまでの、ながさがすくないこと。
16. 見比べる：ふたついじょうのものをみて、ちがいなどをしらべること。
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades: use yellow, orange, blue, green, brown, grey clothing and objects. Magenta ONLY in the grid lines. No jersey numbers.
